en: ONE SCAN FOR THE DAY (10 Sep 2026). Read directly from Chrome: GSC, GA4, the Ahrefs web UI, Brand Radar, the dxliving.com origin and the social dashboard. A normal one-day step from the 9 Sep report.

GSC 28-DAY FELL ON EVERY METRIC: 53 clicks (down 8), 1,546 impressions (down 50), CTR 3.4% (down 0.4), average position 29.4 (WORSE by 0.9), 107 queries (down 15). The window slid ONE day: 11 Aug - 7 Sep.

FULL EXPLANATION - THIS IS THE WINDOW, NOT A RANKING EVENT: the window dropped 10 Aug (the biggest single day in this month's series) and added 7 Sep (0 clicks, 85 impressions). That swap accounts for all four falls. Impressions were summed by hand across all 28 DAYS rows = 1,546; the Total impressions tile only shows a rounded '1.55K'. Cross-check: the same 28 rows sum to 53 clicks, matching the Total clicks tile exactly.

QUERIES: the 107 visible rows account for 47 of 53 clicks and 1,042 of 1,546 impressions; the rest sits in Google's anonymised long tail. Brand takes 46 of 53 clicks = 86.8% (dxliving 30 + dx living 16). dx_models held its 1 click for a FOURTH day. NOT ONE non-brand query has produced a click in the entire series.

THE EIGHT NON-BRAND QUERIES: five lost ground, two sat perfectly still, one gained. '3d renders for property developers melbourne' slipped 28.0 -> 29.8 but took the biggest impression gain of the day, 60 -> 69. '3d renders for builders melbourne' 11.2 -> 11.5 remains the closest non-brand query to page one. '3d rendering melbourne' and '3d rendering services melbourne' were absolutely flat on both position and impressions.

GA4 28-DAY ROSE: 557 sessions (up 19), 2,830 events (up 90), 307 users (up 9), engagement rate 43.09% (up 0.34), 7 key events (flat). Window 13 Aug - 9 Sep. FROM TODAY THE 'UNDER-COUNT' LABEL IS DROPPED: the window starts 13 Aug, three days clear of the 29 Jul - 12 Aug data loss.

CHANNELS: Organic Search 171 -> 182 (+11) stretched its lead over Organic Social 161 -> 164 (+3) to eighteen sessions. Direct 197 -> 202 (+5) still leads overall but the Direct-to-Organic-Search gap narrowed from 26 to 20 sessions in one day. Organic Search remains the ONLY channel producing value: 66.48% engagement, 1m 42s, 5 of the 7 key events.

KEY-EVENT ALARM, SEVENTH SCAN: BOTH 7-day windows (3-9 Sep and 27 Aug - 2 Sep) read ZERO key events. All 7 key events in the 28-day window therefore fall before 27 Aug.
